# DrawDesk

> A free planner for UK limited company directors. It finds the salary, dividend
> and employer pension mix that leaves the most take-home pay for a given company
> profit, for 2025/26 and 2026/27, and models spreading a one-off pot over
> several tax years.

## Key facts
- One director, England, Wales and Northern Ireland; 2025/26 and 2026/27.
- 2026/27 dividend rates: 10.75% basic, 35.75% higher, 39.35% additional; £500 allowance.
- Employer National Insurance: 15% above £5,000. No Employment Allowance for a single director.
- Corporation Tax: 19% up to £50,000, 25% above £250,000, marginal relief between.
- Worked example: £60,000 profit, 2026/27 -> £12,570 salary, £37,498.54 dividends, £46,091.20 take-home.
- Not tax advice. Rates last reviewed 11 November 2026.
